title: A taste of Andalusian culture - wonderful show
text: The flamenco show was the highlight of this tour and we really enjoyed it. The dancers were very talented and the food was good. The city tour was also very good and our guide very informative.
author: Kellie_G

title: Flamenco evening
text: Really enjoyable evening.  Great tour prior to an excellent show. Meal was fantastic. Much better than expected.
author: Paula_S

title: Great way to start your trip in Seville
text: The rest of the group didn’t turn up so I ended up having a private tour of the city. I also had a table to myself at the flamenco show so I could spread out. I opted for the meal with drinks included. There was cured meats and cheese, goats cheese starter, followed by glazed salmon and then slow cooked beef. The dessert was melt in the middle chocolate pudding. Everything was really tasty and well presented. The show itself was really entertaining and I’m glad I booked this, a great way to start my weekend in Seville!
author: reneemarysims

title: Amazing Flamenco Show
text: Our tour guide was a gentleman (sorry, I didn't get his name). We stopped at Plaza de España and he explained many interesting facts. We are glad that we had a chance to visit this wonderful place at night. The flamenco show was at El Palacio Andaluz. The performance was amazing. It exceeded our expectations. We also like the convenience of the transportation before and after the show. It's also worth mentioning that we had to change our pick up location a couple of times due to our other schedule change, this tour company responded promptly to us each time. Thanks again!
author: jjyang11503

title: Wonderful Flamenco Show at El Palacio Andaluz
text: The tour was provided by Viajes Boreal S.A.  We were able to visit Plaza de España after dark. The flamenco show was at El Palacio Andaluz. It was an amazingly great show. It exceeded our expectations. Also very responsive communications prior to the tour began. We had to change our pick up location a couple of times due to our other schedule change. Viajes Boreal S.A. was very easy to work with. Highly recommended.
author: James_Y

title: Birthday
text: It was a surprise present for my son who was 46 yrs old. My son and I have not had a holiday together for nearly 30 yrs ( too many girlfriends ) and we had a wonderful time just the two of us. The food was amazing and the show was unbelievable. We were sat near the front and were quite concerned that the dancers would be on our  table!! Of course they were not. Unmissable
author: Bimbleler

title: Nice show for those interested in Flamenco
text: The Flamenco show is good.  Suggest that the night Tour can visit more places, Tour guide “Madam Snow” is knowledgeable.
author: starkw

title: Wonderful show and meal
text: The show was very nice, better than expected.  The meal was outstanding, quality, quantity, presentation and taste were all on point, would recommend everyone to see it.
author: 395lucilled

title: Excellent tour
text: The tour was excellent, we were picked up at our hotel, toured the area then we went to the Flamenco show were we had an excellent supper whtching an excellent show!
